propositions: Completion verification repeatedly fails without producing a verdict due to runaway duplicate tool-call loops, request-budget exhaustion, or token exhaustion, leaving no scored or signed verdict.
The recovery workflow fans out one isolated LLM run per criterion (22 criteria × 20-request budget = 440 worst-case requests with context re-sends), causing resource waste and predictable failure.
Recovery context bound of 100,000 chars is too restrictive and rejects valid tickets like c9f7 (121,147 chars) because ticket context is append-only and grows indefinitely.
Runs that bank intermediate criterion verdicts before failure should recover to a full-coverage verdict instead of dying verdict-less.
Duplicate read-only tool calls within a single agentic run are re-executed instead of memoized, causing wasteful redundant requests.
